```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  var track = document.getElementById('session-track');
  var prev = document.getElementById('session-prev');
  var next = document.getElementById('session-next');
  if (!track || !prev || !next) return;

  function step() {
    var card = track.querySelector('.session-card');
    if (!card) return track.clientWidth;
    var gap = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(track).gap) || 0;
    return card.getBoundingClientRect().width + gap;
  }

  function updateArrows() {
    var maxScroll = track.scrollWidth - track.clientWidth;
    prev.disabled = track.scrollLeft <= 1;
    next.disabled = track.scrollLeft >= maxScroll - 1;
    // Nothing to scroll at all: hide both rather than show two disabled buttons.
    var hasOverflow = maxScroll > 1;
    prev.style.display = hasOverflow ? '' : 'none';
    next.style.display = hasOverflow ? '' : 'none';
  }

  prev.addEventListener('click', function () {
    track.scrollBy({ left: -step(), behavior: 'smooth' });
  });
  next.addEventListener('click', function () {
    track.scrollBy({ left: step(), behavior: 'smooth' });
  });

  track.addEventListener('scroll', updateArrows);
  window.addEventListener('resize', updateArrows);
  updateArrows();
})();
</script>
```
